description: The minimum the popup window needs: show and hide itself, and drag a frameless window by its header. Two plugins are registered in `lib.rs` and deliberately granted nothing here. `clipboard-manager`: every clipboard write goes through one of our own commands — `copy_item`, which takes an id so a sensitive item's plaintext never has to enter the WebView, or `copy_text`, for text the WebView already holds. Pairing credentials never have a clipboard route. `clipboard-manager:allow-write-text` is withheld: the grant is permanent and unconditional, so any script in the page could write the system clipboard with nothing of ours in the path, whereas the command surface keeps the complete list of writers in `generate_handler!` and greppable. `dialog`: the save and open panels are driven from Rust in `commands::transfer`, so the chosen path is used on that side and never crosses the bridge (CLAUDE.md rule 4) — a JS grant would hand the WebView a way to obtain one. The app's own `#[tauri::command]`s are not gated by this file; only core and plugin commands are.
